publication.edition: English translation of the Bengali Jivan-smriti (Bengali original listed 1911) by Surendranath Tagore, supervised by the author

verification.verification_notes: Publication (London: Macmillan & Co., 1917), translator (Surendranath Tagore, under the author's supervision), and relationship to the Bengali Jivan-smriti confirmed via the Visva-Bharati official English-books listing and academic citations (Marsh 2013; India Seminar). Bengali original listed 1911 (works-list record, accessed 2026-09-24); full Bengali serialization history not pinned this pass.

limitations: Translated under the author's supervision, but Bengali rhythmic and idiomatic texture is not carried; the reflective-evaluative cadence observed in English is partly the translator's.

copyright.notes: 1917 English edition is in the public domain in the United States (pre-1929); confirm local jurisdiction before copying. No passages reproduced in this silo regardless.
